digest.component_or_area: plan-review-gate dogfood monitoring and criterion promotion-gate
propositions: A standing, sidecar-native recorder accumulates per-criterion firing history incrementally without git-object walks or LLM calls, enabling zero-marginal-cost dogfood monitoring for advisory criteria promotion.

The recorder computes detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later suppressed via dropped decision) over a trailing window of reviewed tickets, distinct from and complementary to R7's outcome-corpus metrics.
The recorder is idempotent with dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id) and auto-includes every criterion id observed without per-criterion registration or wiring.
The recorder's append-only ledger is prune-immune to the sidecar's 50-round-per-ticket retention prune, preserving firing history that live sidecar queries would lose.
The implementation is deterministic, zero-LLM, and modeled on R7's harness precedent with --record/--backfill and --report modes and committed metrics over the existing corpus.
